system.description:
• You have turned the death arts inward, transforming your own body towards undeath. You are neither fully living nor fully dead: something in between, and growing less alive with each level.
  • Necrotic Touch
  • A touch attack: 1d6 necrotic damage (+1 die at 5th, 11th and 17th level), and you gain temporary HP equal to half the damage
  • Undying Constitution
  • You do not need to eat, drink, or sleep: 4 hours of trance suffices for long rest benefits
  • Advantage on saves vs poison, disease, and paralysis
  • Detect Undead is always prepared and costs no slot; from 3rd level, cast Speak with Dead once a day without a slot
  • From 9th level you are immune to poison and disease from a creature or source of your Level or lower (you keep your Advantage against the rest), and have Resistance 5 to necrotic damage

activities.name: Necrotic Touch
activities.text: Make an unarmed attack roll first (the Unarmed Strike action); on a hit, your touch deals this, and you gain temporary HP equal to half the damage.
